reason: It's a brand-new shop with no reviews, no Trustpilot and nothing shipped yet, and they want me to pay to reserve socks with no delivery date. I don't buy from places I can't check, and Zalando or ASOS already have funny socks I can get this week.
objection: Paying a deposit for something that might never get made, with zero proof anyone has ever received an order from them.
would_change_my_mind: A real Trustpilot page or a bunch of customer reviews and unboxing photos showing the socks actually ship and the quality holds up.
